statement: Make Group wraps a selection in a group with its own context, name and edit state, isolating geometry from the rest of the model.
superiority: Groups are lightweight components with optional definition sharing.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Group 30 faces; geometry no longer merges with surrounding geometry; ungroup restores. | SUDOC section SUDOC_GRP30 (dino8-app/tests/sections/104_sudoc_grp30.sh, independent oracle: rwi_oracle.py, a plain OBJ reader): 35 unit planes, 30 of them grouped; SelGroup reaches exactly those 30 (OBJ: 30 parts, bounding box (0,0,0)-(59,1,0), none of the 5 loose planes), Ungroup leaves no group (the app's expect_selected 0) and all 35 export again (35 parts, bounding box to x 109); decoys: 31 and 30 parts are rejected by the oracle. Scope: objects are separate B-reps, so 'geometry no longer merges' has no counterpart; edit contexts, names and the dimmed outside are not covered. statement: Make Unique copies a definition so one instance can be edited independently.
superiority: Make unique with automatic naming and link to parent.

statement: Component axes set the insertion point and orientation when placed; Set Component Axes edits them.
superiority: Multiple named insertion points.
notes: also: https://help.sketchup.com/en/sketchup/adjusting-components-insertion-point Acceptance sketch: Change axes; instances' world geometry unchanged and new placements use new origin.

statement: Components can glue to faces (any, horizontal, vertical, sloped), cut openings in faces, and always face the camera.
superiority: Cut openings are non-destructive boolean relations.
notes: Acceptance sketch: Place a window component on a wall; opening cut in the wall and removed on delete.
